title: New Prenylated Isoflavonoids From Erythrina addisoniae With Anti-Neuroinflammatory Activity via Nuclear Factor Kappa-Light-Chain-Enhancer of Activated B Cells Pathway Suppression.
authors: An, Jin-Pyo; Seong, Gi Hyeon; Che, YunHui; Ponce-Zea, Jorge-Eduardo; Mai, Van-Hieu; Ndinteh, Derek Tantoh; Mbafor, Joseph Tanyi; Oh, Won Keun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究刺桐属异黄酮的抗神经炎症活性，仅涉及小分子与NF-κB蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Recent investigations have identified prenylated isoflavonoids as major constituents of Erythrina addisoniae, yet their anti-neuroinflammatory potential remains unexplored. Through bioassay-guided isolation, two new prenylated isoflavonoids (1 and 2), along with nine known compounds (3-11), were characterized using spectroscopic methods. All isolates were tested for inhibitory effects on nitric oxide (NO) production in BV-2 microglial cells. Compounds 1, 6, 7, and 10 significantly reduced NO levels, with compounds 1 and 10 showing the strongest activity (IC(50) values of 3.57 +/- 1.22 and 0.69 +/- 0.18 microM, respectively). Western blot analysis confirmed the downregulation of inducible NO synthase protein, and molecular docking analysis revealed that compound 10 interacts with nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells. These results highlight prenylated isoflavonoids from E. addisoniae as potential anti-neuroinflammatory agents.
abstract_zh: 近期研究已确定异戊烯基异黄酮类化合物为刺桐（Erythrina addisoniae）的主要成分，但其抗神经炎症潜力尚未被探索。通过生物测定引导的分离，利用光谱方法鉴定了两种新的异戊烯基异黄酮类化合物（1和2），以及九种已知化合物（3-11）。所有分离物均测试了其对BV-2小胶质细胞中一氧化氮（NO）产生的抑制作用。化合物1、6、7和10显著降低了NO水平，其中化合物1和10表现出最强活性（IC(50)值分别为3.57 ± 1.22和0.69 ± 0.18微摩尔）。Western blot分析证实了诱导型NO合酶蛋白的下调，分子对接分析显示化合物10与活化B细胞的核因子kappa轻链增强子相互作用。这些结果突显了来自刺桐的异戊烯基异黄酮类化合物作为潜在抗神经炎症药物的可能性。
